$Comment: A spot a panel can sit at: the top-right, above the quest tracker, so that column reads as
one thing. Measured for the World bars (World_Bars), which sit here as shipped: pinned to the
right edge, the panel grows LEFTWARD as columns open and keeps its first column where your eye
already is, and with RowsPerColumn 1 it runs six bars across before it grows downward at all,
which is what keeps it clear of the tracker below.
Position is a corner preset plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins; the preset
names a corner of the screen and is not the spot's id. Columns and RowsPerColumn say how the
rows spread out here. Panels lists which panels offer this spot. LabelKey names it in the HUD
settings, and Order is where it is listed among the spots, lower first.
To retune a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Top_Right' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-spots.json with only the leaves you want different.
